STATUS: fail SUMMARY: Two reproduced blocking issues: the Dialog focus trap leaks when focus lands on the backdrop, and Enter with no active Combobox option submits an enclosing form. Tabs and most Combobox and Dialog criteria held under about 60 probes. Probe file `src/__probe__.test.tsx` was deleted; `git status` matches the starting state. FILES TOUCHED: none FINDINGS: - [blocking] Dialog trap leaks after a backdrop click. With the parent keeping `open` true, `await u.click(backdrop); await u.tab();` moves focus to a button outside the dialog (`active= outside BUTTON`; the probe asserting focus stays inside failed with "expected false to be true"). Cause: the backdrop is not focusable, so focus drops to `body`, and the Tab keydown handler never fires because it is bound on the dialog. README's "Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the dialog" is therefore false in this state. - [blocking] Combobox Enter with no active option inside a `
` submits the form (`submit calls = 1`). README says Enter "Does nothing when no option is active", and the criterion says "does nothing harmful". The handler never calls preventDefault on that path. Decide whether to suppress implicit submission or reword the README. - [minor] Clicking the Combobox input does not open the listbox (`aria-expanded` stayed `false`). The README is silent, but it is a usability gap. - [minor] `description=""` renders an empty `

` and sets `aria-describedby` to it. Reproduced. The criterion says "only when a description is given", so this is an edge-case question. - [minor] Dialog nested inside an open Combobox: the first Escape closes only the listbox and the dialog stays open (reproduced). This matches the README but is arguably at odds with "Escape pressed in a nested input still closes". See OPEN QUESTIONS. - [minor, not reproduced] Tabs `enabled` order is refreshed only when Tabs or a Tab re-renders. A wrapper that reorders children without re-rendering Tabs could leave the fallback tab stop stale. I did not build this case. CHECKS: - Tabs (13 probes) → all pass: controlled parent ignores change and onValueChange still fires; no value/defaultValue with first tab disabled picks first enabled; first and last disabled, ArrowLeft/Right wrap, Home/End land on enabled; one enabled tab, arrows stay put; selected value matching no tab gives exactly one tabIndex 0; defaultValue on a disabled tab gives one tab stop; dynamic middle insert keeps DOM order; weird values ("a b", "ünï ☃", "x/y?z#", quotes/angle brackets, "", "a:b") give unique ids with aria-controls/labelledby resolving; two instances unique ids; className and user onKeyDown/onClick composed; StrictMode; arrows preventDefault; clicking a disabled tab does nothing. - Dialog (17 probes) → pass except D15/F2 above: initial focus on first focusable and container fallback; Tab/Shift+Tab wrap, including from the container; no focusables keeps focus on the container; Escape from a nested input; backdrop closes but inside click does not; focus returns after close with two reopens and under StrictMode; trigger removed before close does not throw; disabled/-1/hidden skipped; element added while open is trapped; onOpenChange not called on mount; labelledby/describedby correct; two instances unique ids; nested Escape closes only the inner dialog when opened by click. - Combobox (~25 probes) → pass: label and listbox aria wiring; case-insensitive substring; "(", ".*", "[", "\\", "+", "?", "$", "^", "*" do not throw; "No results" is not an option and activedescendant is absent; ArrowDown/Up skip disabled and wrap; Enter selects, closes and sets text; Escape restores label with no onChange; clicking enabled selects and disabled does nothing; blur closes; value prop sync including null and ghost values; all-disabled arrows and Enter; onChange(null) once on clear and not when value was null; duplicate labels select by value; filter change while active leaves no dangling id; options swapped while open; controlled parent ignoring a change. - README sentences checked against code: Tabs keyboard and props, Dialog keyboard and props, Combobox keyboard and props. The Dialog trap sentence and the Combobox Enter sentence are contradicted (see findings). OPEN QUESTIONS: (1) Should a Combobox inside a Dialog let the first Escape close the dialog when the listbox is open? The current behavior keeps the dialog open. (2) Should the Enter-submit issue be fixed in code or in the README?
